alex: Quick q — our GHA self-hosted runner seems to be adding a trailing CRLF to the API key file, which breaks Basic auth headers (401). Anyone run into echo vs printf issues in workflow steps?

jess: Yep — plain `echo` appends a newline on most shells. Use `echo -n` or `printf '%s'`. Also watch out for `base64` flags: GNU vs BSD differ (use `-w0` on linux to avoid linewrap).

alex: We're on `ubuntu-latest`. Current workflow step is:
```
run: |
  echo "$API_KEY" > /tmp/redwood_key
  base64 /tmp/redwood_key > /tmp/redwood_key.b64
  curl -H "Authorization: Basic $(cat /tmp/redwood_key.b64)" https://api.redwood.inference/v1/health
```
It works locally but 401 in CI.

maya: Try this instead:
```
run: |
  printf '%s' "$API_KEY" > /tmp/redwood_key
  base64 -w0 /tmp/redwood_key > /tmp/redwood_key.b64
  curl -H "Authorization: Basic $(cat /tmp/redwood_key.b64)" https://api.redwood.inference/v1/health
```
Also, if the secret was copied from Windows, there might be `\r` chars — strip them.

ravi: Good call. Extra safe step we use: `tr -d '\r' < /tmp/redwood_key > /tmp/redwood_key.cleaned` then `base64 -w0 /tmp/redwood_key.cleaned`. Windows editors sneak CRLF into secrets sometimes.

jess: Quick diagnostic you can add to the job to inspect raw bytes (masked in logs if secret):
```
run: |
  echo "${{ secrets.REDWOOD_KEY }}" | od -An -t x1 -v | tr -s ' ' | sed 's/^ //g'
# look for trailing 0a or 0d 0a
```

alex: Thanks — switched to `printf` + `tr -d '\r'` and CI stopped returning 401 locally. One follow-up: after fixing auth, streaming responses from the SDK still failed intermittently with 401 for a bit — probably caused by cached broken token in other steps?

ravi: 401 during streaming usually means the header was malformed at time of request. If you have an earlier step that writes the same file with newline and another step reads it, caching could explain it. Add a `cat` check just before the streaming call or assert header length: `wc -c < /tmp/redwood_key.b64`.

jess: Also remember `base64` on macOS is BSD so `-w0` is not available; use `base64 | tr -d '\n'` there.

ci-bot: workflow "ci/integration" #123 succeeded after the update.

alex: :thumbsup: deploying the fix to staging now; will loop back if anything else pops up. Thanks everyone!
